Return the complete new tools/gpu-bakeoff.mjs (plain ESM; same first line; keep the existing exports and add the new ones named here; compact). Implements docs/plans/swarm-gpu-memory-plan.md section 7 items 4 to 7. (1) LEVELS = Object.freeze([32, 64, 96, 128, 192]); export MAX_MS_PER_TOKEN = 35. (2) measureThroughput results also carry msPerToken = tokPerSecPerAgent > 0 ? round to 1 decimal of 1000 / tokPerSecPerAgent : null. (3) agentsPerGpu(levels, { maxErrorRate = 0.05, maxMsPerToken = MAX_MS_PER_TOKEN } = {}): the highest level whose errorRate <= maxErrorRate and whose msPerToken is a number <= maxMsPerToken; 0 when none. (4) New exported async runUnderLoad({ endpoint, model, agents, fetchImpl = fetch }, fn): starts 'agents' background loops that each keep sending POST endpoint + '/v1/chat/completions' (same body style as measureThroughput, max_tokens 64) one request after another (errors are ignored; a short pause of 10 ms after an error), awaits fn(), then sets a stop flag, awaits all loops, and returns fn's result (also stops the loops if fn throws). agents <= 0 just runs fn. (5) runBakeoff({ candidates, hourlyUsd, capUsd, levels = LEVELS, bestOf = [1, 3], minRemainingHours = 1 }, deps) with deps start, benchmark, throughput, cacheStats, withLoad (optional), now, log: per candidate: (a) skip (record { error: 'skipped: ...' }) when spent >= capUsd as today, or when candidate.optional === true and the time left is below minRemainingHours, where time left = (capUsd - spent) / hourlyUsd hours; (b) start the server; (c) concurrency sweep: for each level call throughput and then cacheStats({ endpoint }); store each level result with cacheHitRate (hitRate or null) added; (d) chosenAgents = agentsPerGpu(measured) or, when 0, the smallest level; (e) pass rate at best-of-N under load: counts = unique sorted [1, ...bestOf]; for each n run benchmark({ endpoint, model, candidate, bestOf: n }) inside (deps.withLoad ?? ((context, fn) => fn()))({ endpoint, model, agents: chosenAgents }, () => benchmark(...)) ; byBestOf entries { n, passed, total, passRate }; the main pass rate/passed/total are the n=1 entry; (f) result fields: label, model, quant, passed, total, passRate, byBestOf, levels, agentsPerGpu (the sweep result; 0 allowed), chosenAgents, cacheHitRate (the last level's), minutes, costUsd (hours since the candidate started times hourlyUsd, 4 decimals), costPerPassUsd (costUsd / passed at n=1, or null when 0 passed); always stop the server in finally and keep the error handling as today. Remove the NVFP4 extra filtering: every candidate runs (the includeExtra option is accepted and ignored). (6) rankResults: failed/skipped candidates last; otherwise ascending costPerPassUsd (null counts as Infinity), ties by higher agentsPerGpu. (7) renderBakeoff({ ranked, spentUsd }, { hourlyUsd, gpu, date, evalTasks, levels }): a summary table with columns Rank | Model | Quant | Cost per passing task | Pass rate N=1 | Pass rate N=3 (at the chosen agent count; the best-of counts other than 1 listed as N=<n>: passed/total) | Max agents (under 35 ms/token) | Chosen agents | Prefix cache hit | Time, cost; and for every successful model a second table titled with the model label with one row per tested level: Agents | ms/token | output tok/s | tok/s per agent | errors | prefix cache hit. Failed or skipped rows show the reason in the Model-row's second cell. Keep the explanatory paragraph but update it: agents per GPU is the highest tested count with under 5% errors and at most 35 ms per token for each agent; best-of-N is measured with background load at the chosen count; ranking is cost per passing task, then agents per GPU. (8) selectCandidates(spec): with no spec return all SHORTLIST entries (copies, including optional, args and env); with a spec resolve labels or model ids against SHORTLIST (copy including args and env) and build { label, model, quant: /nvfp4/i.test(item) ? 'nvfp4' : 'fp8', args: [], env: {} } for unknown ids. Do not edit tests.
